name: Sigmax Advanced FlowMatch Scheduler
plain: The do-it-yourself Sigmax schedule: a straight ramp from sigma_start to sigma_end, then either the exponential-mu shift or the ratio shift with your value, then a 0 appended or the last point kept. The default is exponential-mu with value 0, which bends nothing, so out of the box you get a plain linear ramp from 1 to 0.05 followed by 0. The shift never moves points that sit exactly at 0 or 1. It refuses append_zero when sigma_end is already 0.
math:
Symbols: n steps; s start; e end; v shift value.
append_zero: g_i = s + (e − s)·i/(n−1), i = 0..n−1, then append 0. preserve: same with n+1 points.
exponential_mu: σ = logistic(v − ln((1−g)/g)). direct_ratio: σ = v·g/(1 + (v−1)·g).

props.params: steps=20, sigma_start=1.0, sigma_end=0.05, shift_mode=exponential_mu|direct_ratio, shift_value=0.0, terminal_policy=append_zero|preserve, start_step, end_step
